rows.name:
Peace is the best, isn't it!
Everyone should let Armu-chan
soothe them!

rows.label: tlk41200122_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Armu-chan have a nice natural scent,
and if you ride on their backs,
you'll fall right asleep!

rows.label: tlk41200122_05_msg0003
rows.name:
That's right! Everyone should
raise an Armu-chan!

rows.label: tlk41200122_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Then both Superbia and Invidia
will lose their will to fight!

rows.label: tlk41200122_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Everyone should just take it easy
with Armu-chan!

rows.label: tlk41200122_05_msg0006
rows.name:
It's called Armu-therapy, using the
full healing power of Armu-chan!
